# Million Pack

> > Million Pack provides eco-friendly food packaging solutions including kraft paper bags, PLA containers, and sustainable takeaway packaging for foodservice businesses.

Million Pack specializes in biodegradable and compostable food packaging products, offering comprehensive guides on sustainable materials like PLA, kraft paper, and plant-based alternatives. The site serves wholesale buyers, cafés, and foodservice operators seeking FSC-certified and ASTM D6400/EN 13432 compliant packaging solutions.

## Key Topics

- PLA (Polylactic Acid)
- Kraft paper packaging
- FSC certification
- ASTM D6400 & EN 13432 standards
- Biodegradable packaging
- Compostable materials
- Takeaway packaging
- Sustainable food service
- PE & PBAT coatings
- Eco-friendly inks
- Paper bag manufacturing
- Food safety testing
- Circular economy
- Sugarcane bagasse
- Bamboo alternatives

## Core Product Lines

- [Paper Bags | Million Pack](https://millionpack.com/paper-bags): Eco-friendly kraft paper bags: takeaway, handled, grocery & custom-printed
- [Food Containers | Million Pack](https://millionpack.com/food-containers): PLA, PP & PE food containers: takeaway boxes, bowls & biodegradable options
- [French Fries Packaging | Million Pack](https://millionpack.com/french-fries-packaging): French fries packaging: kraft cones, scoop cups for fast food & takeout
- [Toothpick | Million Pack](https://millionpack.com/toothpick): Wooden toothpicks: round, double-pointed & colored for foodservice use
